source_request: 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independently create and render-test one complex still-frame interpretation of a living person's downward journey from the ordinary world into a visible realm of the dead, using the supplied portrait only as bounded visible face-and-hair appearance reference.
subject: A living adult woman cartographer whose visible face and hair draw only from the supplied appearance reference, without any identity claim.
setting: A steep rain-wet basalt stair descending from a small daylight opening into a cavernous underworld river customs hall.
event: While actively stepping downward, the cartographer reaches a glowing brass astrolabe toward a skeletal ferryman holding a drowned-city map tablet; the light has just broken the ferryman's boat chain and made its dead passengers turn toward her.
visual_priorities: The complete continuous downward route from living-world daylight to the subterranean realm of the dead must be legible in one frame.
The actor, her target-directed action, the ferryman and map-tablet target, and the already-visible broken-chain consequence must all be simultaneously readable.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic documentary-style photograph of a living adult woman cartographer actively descending a steep, rain-wet basalt stair from a small rectangle of daylight into a cavernous realm of the dead. Use the supplied portrait only for visible face and hair appearance: long near-black softly wavy hair with a center part, softly arched brows, almond-shaped brown eyes, and a softly tapered oval face. Her warm flushed skin, condensed breath, and rainwater on her field coat distinguish her from the desiccated dead below. A taut red survey cord runs from her waist continuously up the steps to daylight. While planting one boot on the next lower tread, she reaches a glowing brass astrolabe toward a hooded skeletal ferryman beside a black subterranean river; he visibly holds a cracked ceramic map tablet of a drowned city. The astrolabe light has just split the boat's iron mooring chain, with one opened link falling in sparks as silent dead passengers turn toward her. Frame a wide vertical environmental photograph showing her full figure, the uninterrupted descending stair, ferryman, map tablet, broken chain, black river, and daylight origin together, with cold mineral haze and directional lantern light.
